marketplace.title: Integrations
marketplace.subtitle: Connect Strata to the tools your team already uses — events flow out, work flows back.
marketplace.installDescription: Pick the events to send, paste the incoming webhook URL from the tool, and save. Deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256 and retried automatically.
marketplace.urlHint: Must be an https:// endpoint that accepts POST with a JSON body.
marketplace.eventsHint: Select none to receive every event type.
marketplace.footnote: Every connection here is a signed outbound webhook you can inspect, pause or rotate in
